sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (standard Arogya Sanjeevani SI bands apply per IRDAI mandate)

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on other expenses if higher room taken; pharmacy, consumables, implants, diagnostics excluded from proportionate deduction

icu.note: Proportionate deductions not applicable for ICU room exceeding defined limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment on every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); Modern/listed procedures (robotic surgery etc.): 50% of SI aggregate per policy year

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for ENT, cataract, hernia, piles, calculi etc.; 36 months for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation/treatment explicitly excluded under specific exclusions (7.19)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; per hospitalisation limit

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI for all such claims combined in a policy year

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, diapers etc.) explicitly excluded under List I of Annexure A

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India only (specific exclusion 7.20)

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium; 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly and annual modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary treatment, OPD, treatment outside India, maternity, infertility/IVF, obesity surgery (conditional), refractive error <7.5D
